title: 2749. Minimum Operations to Make the Integer Zero

examples.explanation: We can make 3 equal to 0 with the following operations: - We choose i = 2 and subtract 22 + (-2) from 3, 3 - (4 + (-2)) = 1. - We choose i = 2 and subtract 22 + (-2) from 1, 1 - (4 + (-2)) = -1. - We choose i = 0 and subtract 20 + (-2) from -1, (-1) - (1 + (-2)) = 0. It can be proven, that 3 is the minimum number of operations that we need to perform.
It can be proven, that it is impossible to make 5 equal to 0 with the given operation.
